# 2 Baruch Chapter 58 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**58:1** "And-those-black-waters-which-again-came second-from-the-sea, after-the-first-bright-waters: these-are-all-the-sins-which-Israel-sinned in-the-days-when-the-Egyptians-oppressed-them,"

**58:2** "for-they-made-them-do-service-in-the-building-of-their-cities, and-they-laid-upon-them the-yoke-of-bondage; and-they-humbled-them-with-all-kinds-of-oppression. And-these-are-the-second-black-waters."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
